sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Kiló (kilo) and liter (litre) are measure words that go between egy (a/one) and the noun. The measure word itself stays unchanged; only the noun after it takes the accusative -t.

items.english: I'd like one litre of water.

sections.content: Word order is fixed: egy + kiló/liter + noun-t. Kiló and liter never take -t themselves in this pattern.
